1.1: Should the ascendant lord be in the ascendant itself, the native will be endowed with physical happiness (i.e. good health) and prowess. He will be intelligent, fickle-minded, will have two wives and will unite with other females.
1.2: If the lord of the ascendant is in the 2nd, he will be gainful, scholarly, happy, endowed with good qualities, be religious, honourable, and will have many wives.
1.3: If the lord of the ascendant is in the 3rd, the native will equal a lion in valor, be endowed with all kinds of wealth, be honourable, will have two wives, be intelligent and happy.
1.4: If the ascendant lord is in the 4th, the native will be endowed with paternal and maternal happiness, will have many brothers, be lustful, virtuous, and charming.
1.5: If the ascendant lord is in the 5th, the native will have mediocre progenic happiness, will lose his first child, be honourable, given to anger, and be dear to the king.
1.6: If the ascendant lord is in the 6th and related to a malefic the native will be devoid of physical happiness, and will be troubled by enemies if there is no benefic aspect.
1.7: If the ascendant lord is a malefic and be in the 7th, the native’s wife will not live (long). If the planet in question be a benefic, one will wander aimlessly, face penury (Poverty) and be dejected. He will alternatively become a king (if the said planet is strong). Travels Alot. Listens to Wife
1.8: If the ascendant lord is in the 8th, the native will be an accomplished scholar + Have the Knowledge of Occult Power , be sickly, thievish, be given to much anger, be a gambler, and will join others’ wives.
1.9: If the ascendant lord is in the 9th, the native will be fortunate, dear to people, be a devotee of Sri Vishnu, be skilful, eloquent in speech, and be endowed with wife, sons, and wealth.
1.10: If the ascendant lord is in the 10th, the native will be endowed with paternal happiness, royal honor (or patronage), fame among men and will doubtlessly have self-earned wealth.
1.11: If the ascendant lord is in the 11th, the native will always be endowed with gains, good qualities, fame, and many wives.
1.12: If the ascendant lord is in the 12th, native will be benefic of bodily pleasures. If 12th house is devoid of benefic aspect/conjunction, the native will be bereft of physical happiness, will spend unfruitfully and be given to much anger.

2.1: If the 2nd lord is in the ascendant, the native will be endowed with sons and wealth, be inimical to his family, lustful, hard hearted, and will do others’ jobs.
2.2: If the 2nd lord is in the 2nd, the native will be wealth, proud, will have two or more wives and be bereft of progeny.
2.3: If the 2nd lord is in the 3rd, the native will be valorous, wise, virtuous, lustful, and miserly – all these when related to a benefic. If related to a malefic, the native will be a heterodox (Unorthodox)(Do not Believe in Religion).
2.4: If the 2nd lord is in the 4th, the native will acquire all kinds of wealth. If the 2nd lord is exalted and be conjunct Jupiter, one will be equal to a king.
2.5: If the 2nd lord is in the 5th, the native will be wealthy. Not only the native, but also his sons, will be intent on earning wealth.
2.6:
If the 2nd lord is in the 6th, along with a benefic the native will gain wealth through his enemies
-if be with a malefic, there will be loss through enemies apart from mutilation of shanks.
2.7: If the ascendant lord is a malefic and be in the 7th, the native’s wife will not live (long). If the planet in question be a benefic, one will wander aimlessly, face penury and be dejected. He will alternatively become a king (if the said planet is strong).
2.8: If the 2nd lord is in the 8th, the native will be endowed with abundant land and wealth. But he will have limited material felicity and be bereft of happiness from his elder brother.
2.9: If the 2nd lord is in the 9th, the native will be wealthy, diligent, skillful, sick during childhood, and will later on be happy (i.e. healthy), and will visit shrines observing religious code, etc..
2.10: If the 2nd lord is in the 10th, the native will be libidinous, honorable, learned, will have many wives, and much wealth, but be bereft of filial happiness.
2.11: If the 2nd lord is in the 11th, the native will have all kinds of wealth, be ever diligent, honourable, and famous.
2.12: If the 2nd lord is in the 12th, the native will be adventurous, be devoid of wealth, and be interested in other’s wealth, while his eldest child will not keep him happy.

3.1: If the 3rd lord is in the ascendant, the native will have self-made wealth, be disposed to worship, be valorous, and be intelligent although devoid of learning.
3.2: If the 3rd lord is in the 2nd, the native will be corpulent, devoid of valor, will not make much efforts, be not happy , and will have an eye on others’ wives and others’ wealth.
3.3: If the 3rd lord is in the 3rd, the native will be endowed with happiness through coborn and will have wealth and sons, be cheerful and extremely happy.
3.4: If the 3rd lord is in the 4th, the native will be happy, wealthy and intelligent but will acquire a wicked spouse.
3.5: If the 3rd lord is in the 5th, the native will have sons, and be virtuous. If in the process the 3rd lord be conjunct or aspected by a malefic, the native will have a formidable/cruel wife.
3.6: If the 3rd lord is in the 6th, the native will be inimical to his coborn, be affluent, will not be well disposed to his maternal uncle, and be dear to his maternal aunt.
3.7: If the 3rd lord is in the 7th, the native will be interested in serving the king and be not happy during boyhood but at the end of his life.
3.8: If the 3rd lord is in the 8th, the native will be a thief, will derive his livelihood serving others and will die at the gate of royal palace/Be killed by a king .
3.9: If the 3rd lord is in the 9th, the native will lack paternal bliss, will make fortunes through wife and will enjoy progeny and other pleasures
3.10: If the 3rd lord is in the 10th, the native will have all kinds of happiness and self-made wealth and be interested in nurturing wicked females.
3.11: If the 3rd lord is in the 11th, the native will always gain in trading, be intelligent although not literate, be adventurous, and will serve others.
3.12: If the 3rd lord is in the 12th, the native will spend on evil deeds, will have a wicked father, and will be fortunate through a female (or wife).

4.1: If the 4th lord is in the ascendant the native will be endowed with learning, virtues, ornaments, lands, conveyances, and maternal happiness.
4.2: If the 4th lord is in the 2nd, the native will enjoy pleasures, all kinds of wealth, family life and honor, and be adventurous. He will be cunning in disposition.
4.3: If the 4th lord is in the 3rd, the native will be valorous. He will have servants, be liberal, virtuous and charitable, and possess self-earned wealth. He will be free from diseases
4.4: If the 4th lord is in the 4th, the native will be a minister and will possess all kinds of wealth. He will be skilful, virtuous, honorable, learned, happy, and be well disposed to his spouse.
4.5: If the 4th lord is in the 5th, the native will be happy and be liked by all. He will be devoted to Sri Vishnu, be virtuous, honorable, and will have self-earned wealth.
4.6: If the 4th lord is in the 6th, the native will be devoid of maternal happiness, be given to anger, be a thief and a conjurer (or magician), be independent in action and be ill-disposed.
4.7: If the 4th lord is in the 7th, the native will be endowed with a high degree of education, will sacrifice his patrimony, and be akin to the dumb in an assembly.
4.8: If the 4th lord is in the 8th, the native will be devoid of domestic and other comforts, will not enjoy much parental happiness, and be equal to a neuter.
4.9: If the 4th lord is in the 9th, the native will be dear to one and all, be devoted to God, be virtuous, honorable, and endowed with every kind of happiness
4.10: If the 4th lord is in the 10th, the native will enjoy royal honors, be an alchemist, be extremely pleased, will enjoy pleasures, and will conquer his five senses.
4.11: If the 4th lord is in the 11th, the native will have fear of secret disease, be liberal, virtuous, charitable, and helpful to others.
4.12: If the 4th lord is in the 12th, the native will be devoid of domestic and other comforts, will have vices and be foolish and indolent.

5.1: If the 5th lord is in the ascendant, the native will be scholarly, be endowed with progenic happiness, be a miser, be crooked, and will steal others’ wealth.
5.2: If the 5th lord is in the 2nd, the native will have many sons and wealth, be a pater familiar, be honorable, be attached to his spouse, and be famous in the world.
5.3: If the 5th lord is in the 3rd, the native will be attached to his coborn, be a talebearer, and a miser, and be always interested in his own work.
5.4: If the 5th lord is in the 4th, the native will be happy, endowed with maternal happiness, wealth and intelligence, and be a king or a minister or a preceptor.
5.5: If the 5th lord is in the 5th, the native will have progeny if related to a benefic; there will be no issues if malefic is related to the said 5th lord placed in 5th. The 5th lord in 5th will, however, make one virtuous and dear to friends.
5.6: If the 5th lord is in the 6th, the native will obtain such sons who will be equal to his enemies or will lose them, or will acquire an adopted or purchased son
5.7: If the 5th lord is in the 7th, the native will be honorable, very religious, endowed with progenic happiness and be helpful to others.
5.8: If the 5th lord is in the 8th, putradosha, cough and pulmonary disorders, short tempered and unhappy.
5.9: If the 5th lord is in the 9th, the native will be a prince or equal to him, will author treatises, be famous, and will shine in his race.
5.10: If the 5th lord is in the 10th, the native will enjoy a Rajayoga and various pleasure, and be very famous.
5.11: If the 5th lord is in the 11th, the native will be learned, dear to people, be an author of treatises, be very skilful, and be endowed with many sons and wealth.
5.12: If the 5th lord is in the 12th, the native will be bereft of happiness from his own sons, will have an adopted or purchased son.

6.1: If the 6th lord is in the ascendant, the native will be sickly, famous, inimical to his own men, rich, honorable, adventurous, and virtuous.
6.2: If the 6th lord is in the 2nd, the native will be adventurous, famous among his racemen, will live in alien countries (or places), be happy, be a skillful speaker, and be always interested in his own work.
6.3: If the 6th lord is n the 3rd, the native will be given to anger, be bereft of courage, inimical to all of his coborn, and will have disobedient servants
6.4: If the 6th lord is in the 4th, the native will be devoid of maternal happiness, be intelligent, be a talebearer, be jealous, fickle-minded, and very rich.
6.5: If the 6th lord is in the 5th the native will have fluctuating finances. He will incur enmity with his sons and friends. He will be happy, selfish, and kind.
6.6: If the 6th lord is in the 6th, the native will have enmity with the group of his kinsmen but be friendly to others and will enjoy mediocre happiness in matters like wealth.
6.7: If the 6th lord is in the 7th, the native will be deprived of happiness through wedlock. He will be famous, virtuous, honorable, adventurous, and wealthy.
6.8:
If the 6th lord is in the 8th, the native will be sickly, inimical, will desire others’ wealth, be interested in others’ wives, and be impure (or degraded).
Note: The placement of 6th in the 8th gives diseases to the native as would remain life long and ultimately be the cause of death. If 6th,8th and Saturn Conjunct it will be malefic. 6th is indicator of inauspicious effects. If in the 8th, destroys these inauspiciousness–> Vipareet Rajayoga.
6.9: If the 6th lord is in the 9th, the native will trade in wood and stones (also means poison), and will have fluctuating professional fortunes.
6.10:
If the 6th lord is in the 10th, the native will be well known among his men, will not be respectfully disposed to his father and will be happy in foreign countries. He will be a gifted speaker.
-6th house represents Chemistry,enemies, fights and diseases–> This will make one study Chemistry, Military Science, Law and Medicine.
6.11:
If the 6th lord is in the 11th, the native will gain wealth through his enemies, be virtuous, adventurous, and will be somewhat bereft of happiness through children.
-The native earns wealth through Medicine, enimity with elder sibling, difficulties in fullfillment of desires and progeny after medical intervention.
6.12:
If the 6th lord is in the 12th, the native will always spend on vices, be hostile to learned people, and will torture living beings.
-Native will be of questionable morality, intent on deriving sexual pleasures from other females as well.

7.1:
If the 7th lord is in the ascendant, the native will go to others’ wives, be wicked, skillful, devoid of courage, and afflicted by windy diseases.
Notes: Devoid of Fighting Spirit
7.2: If the 7th lord is in the 2nd, the native will have many wives, will gain wealth through his wife (Wealth After Marriage), and be procrastinating in nature
7.3:
If the 7th lord is in the 3rd, the native will face loss of children and sometimes with great difficulty there will exist a living son. There is also the possibility of birth of a daughter (who will sustain).
-Effect occurs with great cruelty in Taurus Asc as Mars(7th Lord) debilitated
-Effect not found in Leo/Aq Asc
7.4: If the 7th lord is in the 4th, the wife of the native will not be under his control. He will be fond of truth, be intelligent, and religious. He will suffer from dental diseases
7.5:
If the 7th lord is in the 5th, native will be honorable, endowed with all (i.e. seven principal) virtues, always delighted and endowed with all kinds of wealth.
-7th Lord Saturn in 5th house (Delay in marriage)
-During educational Career–> Blossoming of love affairs (Especially in the college)
7.6: If the 7th lord is in the 6th, the native will beget a sickly wife, be inimical to her, given to anger and devoid of happiness.
7.7: If the 7th lord is in the 7th, the native will be endowed with happiness through wife, be courageous, skillful, and intelligent, but only afflicted by windy diseases
7.8: If the 7th lord is in the 8th, the native will be deprived of marital happiness. His wife will be troubled by diseases, be devoid of good disposition, and will not obey the native.
7.9:
If the 7th lord is in the 9th, the native will have union with many women, be well-disposed to his own wife, and will have many undertakings (or assignments).
Note:
1. For Leo and Aq Asc, If 7th Lord in 9th House, native is defamed after having sexual intercourse with other woman. (9th hse is house of fame too.)
2. Fortune in Foreign Lands
7.10: If the 7th lord is in the 10th, the native will beget a disobedient wife, will be religious, and endowed with wealth, sons, etc..
7.11: If the 7th lord is in the 11th, the native will gain wealth through his wife, be endowed with less happiness from sons, etc., and will have more daughters
7.12: If the 7th lord is in the 12th, the native will incur penury, be a miser, and his livelihood will be related to trading (Eg: Clothes, textiles). His wife will be a spendthrift.

8.1:
If the 8th lord is in the ascendant, the native will be devoid of physical felicity, and will suffer from wounds. He will be hostile to gods and brahmins (or religious people)
Note: Libra and Aries Asc, 8th lord in own house. Auspicious Effects –> Healthy, No wounds
            In Pisces ASC, Excellent.
8.2: If the 8th lord is in the 2nd, the native will be devoid of bodily vigor, will enjoy a little wealth, and will not regain lost wealth.
8.3: If the 8th lord is in the 3rd, the native will be devoid of fraternal happiness (Siblings), be indolent and devoid of servants and strength.
8.4: If the 8th lord is in the 4th, the child will be deprived of its mother. He will be devoid of a house, lands, and happiness, and will doubtlessly betray his friends
8.5: If the 8th lord is in the 5th, the native will be dull witted, will have limited number of children, be long lived and wealthy.
8.6: If the 8th lord is in the 6th, the native will win over his enemies, be afflicted by diseases, and during childhood will incur danger through snakes and water.
8.7:
If the 8th lord is in the 7th, the native will have 2 wives. If the 8th lord is conjunct a malefic in the 7th there will surely be downfall in his business (or livelihood/Trade).
Notes: Pisces Asc–> 8th Lord Venus in the 7th is Debilitated. Confirm 2 wives
Virgo Asc–> Mars owns 8th + 3rd. Occupancy in the 7th can cause 2 wives.
8.8: If the 8th lord is in the 8th, the native will be long lived (+ Need to be checked with Shadbhala). If the said planet be weak being in the 8th, the longevity will be medium, while the native will be a thief, be blameworthy, and will blame others well.
8.9:
If the 8th lord is in the 9th, the native will betray his religion be a heterodox, will beget a wicked wife, and will steal others’ wealth
Note: Taurus Asc–>  Jupiter in the Sign of Debilitation. Jupiter Signifies religion. Both Damaged. (Hence, Irreligious)
8.10:
If the 8th lord is in the 10th, the native will be devoid of paternal bliss, be a tale bearer, and be bereft of a livelihood. If there is an aspect in the process from a benefic, then these evils will not mature.
– Native deals with Scrap
– Things mined out of Earth like coal, metals, minerals,Steel
8.11:
If the 8th lord along with a malefic is in the 11th, the native will be devoid of wealth and will be miserable in boyhood but happy later on.
Should the 8th lord be in conjunction with a benefic and be in the 11th, the native will be long lived.
Note: Parasharar has clearly indicated that 8th lord in 11th is good a position if there is a benefic influence on it.
8.12: If the 8th lord is in the 12th, the native will spend on evil deeds and will incur a short life. More so, if there be additionally a malefic in the said house.

9.1:
If the 9th lord is in the ascendant, the native will be fortunate (or prosperous), will be honored by the king, be virtuous, charming, learned, and honored by the public.
-Note:
Taurus Asc- Very Positive + YogaKaraka Sat Aspects 10th House
Cancer Asc- Jupiter Exalted in the 1st House. Fortunate, Charming, Self respecting, Highly Educated, Honoured. THough 6th Lord in Asc –>Destroys all defects.
Virgo & Scorpio Asc (Venus & Moon) in Debilitation. Therefore, not auspicious.
9.2:
If the 9th lord is in the 2nd, the native will be a scholar, be dear to all, wealthy, sensuous, and endowed with happiness from wife, sons, etc..
Notes:
In Aq Asc–>9th Lord (&4th Lord) Venus (YogaKaraka) will be in 2nd House Exalted (Very Powerful)
In Virgo & Pisces Asc (Venu & Mars) in 2nd House in own Signs –> Excellent Results
9.3:
If the 9th lord is in the 3rd, the native will be endowed with fraternal bliss, be wealthy, virtuous, and charming.
Note: Capricon Asc –> This is an Exception
9.4: If the 9th lord is in the 4th, the native will enjoy houses, conveyances, and happiness, will have all kinds of wealth, and be devoted to his mother.
9.5: If the 9th lord is in the 5th, the native will be endowed with sons and prosperity, devoted to elders, bold, charitable and learned.
9.6: If the 9th lord is in the 6th, the native will enjoy meager prosperity, be devoid of happiness from maternal relatives and be always troubled by enemies
9.7:
O Brahmin, if the 9th lord is in the 7th, the native will beget happiness after marriage, be virtuous, and famous.
Note: In Cancer Asc–> Jupiter will be Debilitated. Not good. Hardships Multiplied after marriage.
In Scorpio or Virgo Asc, 9th Lord Exalted. Excellent Effects.
9.8:
If the 9th lord is in the 8th, the native will not be prosperous, and will not enjoy happiness from his elder brother.
Note: For Gemini Asc this does not apply because Saturn in his Own Hse. Bound to confer happiness on the native in the latter half of his life.
In Aq Asc–> Debilitated hence highly inauspicious.
9.9: If the 9th lord is in the 9th, the native will be endowed with abundant fortunes, virtues, and beauty, and will enjoy much happiness from coborn.
9.10: If the 9th lord is in the 10th, the native will be a king or equal to him or be a minister or an army chief, be virtuous, and dear to all.
9.11: If the 9th lord is in the 11th, the native will enjoy financial gains day by day, be devoted to elders, virtuous, and meritorious in acts.
9.12:
If the 9th lord is in the 12th, the native will incur loss of fortunes, will always spend on auspicious acts, and will become poor on account of entertaining guests.
Note: In Aries Asc–> Jupiter will make one generous and will have abundance.
9th Lord in 12 might also means Fortune in Foreign Land

10.1:
If the 10th lord is in the ascendant, the native will be scholarly, famous, be a poet, will incur diseases in boyhood, and be happy later on. His wealth will increase day by day.
Note:
Aries Asc: 10th Lord Saturn will be debilitation. Bad Health + Headache + Reduce Longeivity + Reduce gains of wealth
Cancer Asc: Yogkaraka. Very Auspicious Situation. Lowliness in status and financial position will never be caused. [Might have blood Disorder]
Virgo & Pisces Asc: 10th Lord in their own sign Asc. Very Auspicious.
10.2:
If the 10th lord is in the 2nd, the native will be wealthy, virtuous, honored by the king, charitable, and will enjoy happiness from father and others.
Note:
Gemini ASC: 10th Lord exalted in the 2nd house: Very Powerful–> High Officials in Banks, Finance Ministers, Govt Authority, Amass Wealth
Libra & Leo ASC: May rise but will have falls. Fluctuations in Professions.
10.3:
If the 10th lord is in the 3rd, the native will enjoy happiness from brothers and servants, be valorous, virtuous, eloquent, and truthful.
Note: Usually Engineers
10.4:
If the 10th lord is in the 4th, the native will be happy, be always interested in his mother’s welfare, will lord over conveyances, lands and houses, be virtuous and wealthy.
Note: Usually profession related to Vehicles, Building Material, Agriculture, Dairy
10.5:
If the 10th lord is in the 5th, the native will be endowed with all kinds of learning, be always delighted and be wealthy and endowed with sons.
Note: Very Auspicious because Trine and Kendra related. Highly Intellectual. Statemen, Scholars, Professors, Writers, Educationist, Actors
In Pisces ASC: Very Auspicious because Jupiter is exalted.
10.6:
If the 10th lord is in the 6th, the native will be bereft of paternal bliss. Although he may be skillful, he will be bereft of wealth and be troubled by enemies.
This case is only auspicious for Doctors and Lawyers. In other professions, usually much obstacles. Better to deal with Foreigners.
10.7: If the 10th lord is in the 7th, the native will be endowed with happiness through wife, be intelligent, virtuous, eloquent, truthful, and religious.
10.8:
If the 10th lord is in the 8th, the native will be devoid of (good) acts, longlived, and intent on blaming others.

Note: If native deals with Scraps, Mineral Substances, LIC, Leather goods –> Special Success.
Some choose Immoral professions too.
10.9:
If the 10th lord is in the 9th, one born of royal scion will become a king, whereas an ordinary native will be equal to a king. This placement will confer wealth and progenic happiness, etc.. [Trine and Kendra Related]
Note: Only in Capricon ASC this is not good . Because Venus is Debilitated.
10.10: If the 10th lord is in the 10th, the native will be skillful in all jobs, be valorous, truthful, and devoted to elders.
10.11: If the 10th lord is in the 11th, the native will be endowed with wealth, happiness, and sons, virtuous, truthful
10.12:
If the 10th lord is in the 12th, the native will spend through royal abodes (i.e. kings)/Spend on State, will have fear from enemies and will be worried in spite of being skilful
Note: 10th Lord in 6th,8th & 12th troubles from Royal Side.
Taurus and Scorpio ASC–> Very inauspicious

11.1: If the 11th lord is in the ascendant, the native will be genuine in disposition, be rich, happy, even sighted, be a poet, be eloquent in speech, and be always endowed with gains.
11.2: If the 11th lord is in the 2nd, the native will be endowed with all kinds of wealth and all kinds of accomplishments, be charitable, religious, and always happy.
11.3: If the 11th lord is in the 3rd, the native will be skilful in all jobs, wealthy, endowed with fraternal bliss, and may sometimes incur gout pains.
11.4: If the 11th lord is in the 4th, the native will gain from maternal relatives, will undertake visits to shrines, and will possess happiness of house and lands [Native usually earns wealth through sale of lands, transport, agriculture and Nursery
11.5:
If the 11th lord is in the 5th, the native’s children will be happy, educated, and virtuous. He will be himself religious and happy.
Note: May Study Commerce and good for studies.
Sc Asc–> Mercury is Debilitated.
11.6:
If the 11th lord is in the 6th, the native will be afflicted by diseases, be cruel, living in foreign places, and troubled by enemies.
Note: Gemini ASC–> Mars (11th Lord and 6th Lord) in own sign. May have to confront enemies but not be troubled by them.
11.7:
If the 11th lord is in the 7th, the native will always gain through his wife’s relatives, be liberal, virtuous, sensuous, and will remain at the command of his spouse.
Note: Aries and Libra Asc–> Saturn & Sun in Exaltation. Special gains via wife. Generally married in rich family.
Gemini ASC–> Not good because Mars (11th & 6th Lord) in the 7th house. 6th Lord in 7th is not good. Opposition from wife.
Leo & Aquarius ASC (11th Lord Mer & Jup) also owns 2nd lord. Very Auspicious in 7th house.
Wealth increases greatly after marriage.
Capricon Asc–> 11th Lord Mars in 7th house debilitated. Not good for marriage. Engagements called off.
11.8:
If the 11th lord is in the 8th, the native will incur reversals in his undertakings and will live long while his wife will predecease him.
Leo & Aq Asc–> Inauspcious but gains in dealings with scraps/trade, leather, mineral substances.
Leo ASC: Long lived does not work because MER is debilitated.
Gemini and Pisces ASC: 11th Lord Exalted.
11.9:
If the 11th lord is in the 9th, the native will be fortunate, skillful, truthful, honored by the king, and be affluent
Note: Very Fortunate. Usually don’t even need to work hard to earn wealth. Gets wealth through Shares, Lottery and speculation.
11.10:
If the 11th lord is in the 10th, the native will be honored by the king, be virtuous, attached to his religion, intelligent, truthful, and will subdue his senses
Aies ASC: 11th Lord Sat in Own Sign. This is good but success comes a little delayed. Gains through Profession. Believe in doing religious rites. Success through prayers/occult prayers. Acquire through shares.
Taurus & Scorpio ASC: 11th Lord Jup is also 8th lord. Hence, such native tendency to make income unethical.
 Gemini ASC: Income Tax Officer, Criminal Court, Doctor
Sagitarrius ASC: Income Tax dept, Criminal court , Hospitals but they work in lower grade professions. [Debilitation of 11th lord]
Cancer ASC: Automobile, Dairy, Transport Business, Home Reno, Buildings,
Leo & Aq ASC: Banks, Sales Tax, Income Tax, Trading
Virgo& Libra: Trades in Shares
Capricon ASC: Building and construction, Sales and Purchase of lands, Property,
Pisces ASC: Gains wealth from Foreign Countries
11.11: If the 11th lord is in the 11th, the native will gain in all his undertakings, while his learning and happiness will be on the increase day by day.
11.12: If the 11th lord is in the 12th, the native will always expend on good deeds, be sensuous, will have many wives, and will befriend barbarians (or foreigners in general).

12.1:
If the 12th lord is in the ascendant, the native will be a spendthrift, be weak in constitution, will suffer from phlegmatic disorders, and be devoid of wealth and learning.
12th Lord in 1st house means destruction of Lagna. And such a native will not be greedy about wealth.
12.2:
If the 12th lord is in the 2nd, the native will always spend on auspicious deeds, be religious, will speak sweetly, and be endowed with virtues and happiness.
– Aries & Libra ASC –> Jupiter and Mercury become 9th And 12th Lord. Spend on Auspicious or Religious grounds.
– Sag & Gemini ASC–> Mars & Venus become 12th and 5th lord. Spend on auspicious deeds.
– Taurus & Scorpio –> Mars and Venus become 12th and 7th Lord. Spend on woman/Lustful desires.
– Pisces ASC–> Saturn Debilitated. Not Auspicious.
12.3: If the 12th lord is in the 3rd, the native will be devoid of fraternal bliss, will hate others, and will promote self-nourishment (i.e. be quite selfish).
12.4:
If the 12th lord is in the 4th, the native will be devoid of maternal happiness and will day by day accrue losses in respect of lands, conveyances, and houses.
– Native usually sells lands/house/cars to earn wealth. Loss of wealth day by day
– Gemini & Leo ASC–> Venus and Moon debilitated. Devoid of Maternal Bliss.
– Aries & Scorpio ASC–> Jupiter &  Speical Maternal Bliss 12th Lord Exalted.
12.5:
If the 12th lord is in the 5th, the native will be bereft of sons and learning. He will spend as well as visit shrines in order to beget a son.
-Usually education in foreign lands
-Education in own land but from a hostel.
12.6: If the 12th lord is in the 6th, the native will incur enmity with his own men, be given to anger, be sinful, miserable, and will go to others’ wives.
12.7: If the 12th lord is in the 7th, the native will incur expenditure on account of his wife, will not enjoy conjugal bliss, and will be bereft of learning and strength.
12.8:
If the 12th lord is in the 8th, the native will always gain, will speak affably, will enjoy a medium span of life and be endowed with all good qualities.
-Vipareet Raj Yoga.
12.9: If the 12th lord is in the 9th, the native will dishonor his elders/Teachers, be inimical even to his friends, and be always intent on achieving his own ends.
12.10: If the 12th lord is in the 10th, the native will incur expenditure through royal persons and will enjoy only moderate paternal bliss.
12.11: If the 12th lord is in the 11th, the native will incur losses, be brought up by others, and will sometimes gain through others wealth.
12.12: If the 12th lord is in the 12th, the native will only face heavy expenditure, will not have physical felicity, be irritable, and spiteful.
